rows.quote: The present study was approved by UK Biobank under application number 19542.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rule C): the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by an application number (19542; the Data availability passages say phenotypic and genetic data at the individual level) and by a phenotype definition (the modified Fried frailty phenotype in the Outcome definitions passage), not only by a number of participants; no release, accession or citation of a dictionary row is given.
